description: This file contains the implementation of the BankTransfer payment model class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines methods related to retrieving available payment options for bank transfer, considering geographic zones and configuration settings.

classes.name: BankTransfer
classes.description: A model class for handling bank transfer payment method logic, including fetching available payment options based on geographic zones and configuration.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available bank transfer payment methods based on the customer's address and other conditions such as subscription status and geo zone restrictions.
